final: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws),''),'') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
